stopping_rule_application: NEITHER of DEC-20260806-1ac8fa's two named outcomes (scale to full run / PAUSE) applies cleanly. Both reviewers confirm the injection mechanism is genuine and sound -- no structural redesign needed. But the Red Team demonstrated the pilot's between-shard comparison design has standard errors 2.8-10.6x wider than a matched-pair design would give, so the clean null cannot distinguish a genuine near-zero effect from a real effect of the size the point estimates suggest. This decision names a bounded, largely-free three-step resolution path (matched-pair reanalysis, real power derivation, then a positive control only if still ambiguous) before either of the original stopping-rule branches is applied, rather than forcing a premature choice under genuine statistical ambiguity.
